title: At the garage
instructions: Lisa arabasını tamirhaneye götürüyor. Sorunu, süreyi ve fiyatı takip et.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: Hi. My car is making a strange noise when I stop.

script.speaker: mech
script.text: That sounds like the brakes. When did it start?

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: About a week ago. It's getting worse.

script.speaker: mech
script.text: Let me have a look. Yes, you need new brakes at the front.

script.speaker: mech
script.text: We're busy today. You can collect it tomorrow at about three.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: And how much will it cost?

script.speaker: mech
script.text: Around two hundred pounds, with the parts.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: That's more than I expected, but OK. Safety first!

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the car?
options: It makes a noise when she stops.
questions.feedback: Araba dururken garip bir ses çıkarıyor.
